entity.name: Azubuike Golden
entity.description: Software developer and creator and maintainer of Mongeesy, a free and open source interactive MongoDB tutorial that runs entirely in the browser.

projects.name: Mongeesy
projects.description: A free, open source, in-browser MongoDB tutorial and playground. Learners write real MongoDB shell queries against sample data and get instant feedback across 35 progressive lessons, with no installation, account or server. A custom query engine runs entirely in the browser, and the app works offline as an installable PWA, which makes it usable in classrooms and places with unreliable internet.
